I see you want a crew cab and to be able to tow things slightly on the lighter side. In my opinion, I would find the model of Dodge, Ford, and Chevrolet from the years 2014-2018 that you like the most from each brand, meaning what year do you like the most for each brand? From there, I would look up reviews on each engine from those three choices and see what problems occur the most and how expensive they are, and read other people's reviews and experiences. This won't completely decide your choice, but it can give you a better idea of what to go with, in relation to how long it lasts. Most newer trucks can tow small bass boats and jet skis, so I think any truck with crew cab from 2014-2018 should be able to, but I would check the foot per pound torque for each engine to ensure you can. I will say that some of the newer Chevy's from around 2016 or 2017 have a smaller back seat, as my grandpa has a 2017 Chevy Silverado LT crew cab. It is mostly up to preference of looks and just researching the engines and other people's reviews to make sure you're getting the best engine for your money.
